title: pending_item_ops
summary: MSUI implements the client-side pending-operation lock including Benilla's deliberate widening: _pendingBagLocks records the (guid, stack count) baseline for both ends of a move at send time (AddPendingBagLock on carried source + destination), IsInventorySlotLocked greys/disables the covered slots, and ObserveBagLocks clears an entry when the slot's current guid OR count diverges from the baseline - the same resolving field-update watch that catches same-guid split-merges.

openItems.text: SMSG_INVENTORY_CHANGE_FAILURE is not handled anywhere (opcode absent from the switch): a server-refused move never unlocks the slots promptly (and surfaces no error) - MSUI substitutes a 5-second timeout, so a refused operation leaves slots dark for up to 5s where the reference unlocks on the failure packet
